name: Ren'ai Princess ~Nisemono Hime to 10-nin no Kon'yakusha~
original_name: 恋愛プリンセス～ニセモノ姫と10人の婚約者～
source:
"Please just switch with me for one night."

One day a princess with the same face as you appears before you and asks for you to go to a party in her place. It happens to be an engagement party with 10 different suitors vying to be the princess's husband.
